root.label: Seventh Circuit affirms dismissal of AI-generated CSAM possession charge

events.label: Seventh Circuit affirms dismissal of AI-generated CSAM possession charge

slots.name: charges filed
slots.sentence: Anderegg was charged with producing and distributing the AI-generated material, transferring it to a minor under 16, and possessing it.

slots.name: charges remaining
slots.sentence: A federal district court dismissed only the possession charge on First Amendment grounds, leaving the other three charges intact.
